Pune . Such manpower will be part of total manpower to be provided by the Service Provider in case he gets the contract against this bid. 14. The contractor shall be provide only those worker/ employees whose antecedents have been verified by the police. 5. The vendor should make the payment of employee on time (before the 7th of every month), and forwa rd the all supportive documents to this office by 10th of ever month, as further payment process is carried by PCDA Navy, Mumbai. 11. Documents required are : 11.1 MSME Certificate 11.2 Past experience 11.3 Bidder Turnover 11.4 Proof of office location in Maharashtra State 11.5 Seal and Signed Bid Compliance/acceptance 11.6 Seal and Signed ATC Compliance/acceptance
